hero.description: French passionate junior developer creating some random stuff. I like making apps with new tech and bringing creative ideas to life through code.

about.title: About

age16.text: Got interested in dev. First goal: making Discord bots.

error.text: Turns out it wasn’t as simple as I thought — moved to web development, started, then quickly stopped.

reboot.text: Since AI arrived, I understood it’s a very powerful tool for learning.

fuel.text: Seeing the ideas in my head come to life gives me a dose of adrenaline.

now.text: I keep building projects in my corner. Freelancing tempts me, but studies come first.

about.ps: ps: I still use AI to help me ;)
